answer: Winter camps on the tundra may occupy only a hard-capped set of numbered radio stakes, one per signing key. At enrollment the operator leaves a uniquely veined onyx datum weight on the supply jetty scale; customs publishes the laser inclusion map and binds it to that key and stake. Auditors later recall the weight to the same jetty, re-scan the veins, and require a signature over a fresh nonce. A second key on the same stake or weight forfeits the season bond. A hundred fake names require a hundred scarce stakes and a hundred assayed stones, so attacker cost stays at least linear.
